role: Tests for CoachVoiceGuard, the runtime output perimeter that rewrites sentences carrying regulated medical claims or offensive terms: concept/rule/deflection coverage, volume (no rewrite cap), byte-identical clean sentences, straddling-match fail-closed fallback, rule precedence, word boundaries, per-locale positives and false-positive checks, streaming split helpers, a pre-check timing measure, and the offensive-term lists (every-reply vs English-only).
types: CoachVoiceGuardTests: class — XCTestCase (plus an extension for offensive-language tests)

flags.text: CoachVoiceGuard's doc (CoachVoiceGuard.swift, '## Wiring') still says CoachVoiceGuardTests asserts that StreamTextBuffer.flush and VoiceConversationController.speak call the guard; no test here (or elsewhere in EmuquTests) touches StreamTextBuffer, VoiceConversationController.speak or applyPostStreamEffects — testProhibitedPhraseIsNeverPublishedDuringStreaming replays the buffer loop with the guard's own functions — so removing a production call site would leave the suite green. This file's header now says so; the source doc and a call-site test need changes outside the test file (handoff).

Several assertions compare against English deflection copy ('healthcare professional', offensiveLanguageRule.deflection substring) or check only the current-language deflection, but the class never pins the app language; deflections resolve through LanguageManager.appBundle, so results depend on the host language.
